regime_context: The detector shows a semiconductor-dominant leadership stack — AI Infrastructure (rank 1), Memory/HBM (2), and WFE (3) are all eligible and trend-healthy, with the absolute-trend gate validated as risk control on this market's history. Rotation breadth is narrowing (20/49 eligible), one-narrative is false, and no confirmed handoff exists, so this is a disciplined-trend environment, not a predictive one.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Memory, HBM & Storage (rank 2, score 1.873, durability 0.72, trend tag) closes the 0.422 score gap with AI Infrastructure AND breadth_of_rotation flips from 'narrowing' to stabilizing or widening — that combination would be a confirmed handoff of leadership within the semiconductor complex, retiring this watch.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the top-ranked theme and the rotation leader, with a healthy durability_bar (0.71), broad participation (0.875 breadth), and no crowding flag. The supportive leg is the absolute-trend gate discipline combined with leader-status durability — not the rank itself. Given gate_helps is true on this market, staying with the eligible leader aligns with the only validated edge (drawdown control), while broad breadth suggests leadership is shared across constituents rather than a single crowded name.
theses.dissent: SMH is a broad semiconductor proxy shared by all three top themes, so 'AI Infrastructure' leadership may be a proxy artifact of semiconductor beta rather than a distinct thematic edge; if the whole semi complex corrects, this theme has no independent protection.

falsifier.text: SMH lags SPY by 5% total return before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the only eligible theme among the top five with a distinct, unambiguous trend tag (hurst_tag='trend'), perfect breadth (1.0), and the highest durability_bar (0.83) in the top ranks. It is the strongest-quality (not strongest-momentum) eligible theme. The crowding flag is treated strictly as a size-down caution, not a fade. This is a durability-led preference expressed as a conditional lean.
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity is the only crowded theme in the top tier (crowding_z 1.97), and crowding flags a late-stage leadership texture; a sharp mean-reversion in crowded software/security names is the documented concern.

falsifier.text: CIBR lags SMH by 8% before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners is ineligible (eligible=false) with a decayed durability_bar of 0.15, a mean-revert hulst tag, and very poor breadth (0.25) — exactly the profile the absolute-trend gate is designed to filter out. The lean is avoid (not underweight/short) because this is a size/risk-discipline call, not a directional fade. This is the clearest application of the validated drawdown-avoidance edge.
theses.dissent: Silver miners have high idiosyncratic beta and can spike on single macro events (USD weakness, inflation surprise); avoiding them forgoes a short-lived but violent rally, though the detector would flag that only after a confirmed re-entry above trend.

falsifier.text: SIL rises 15% AND its durability_bar crosses back above 0.5 before the 30-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
